title: Bird of Paradise
synopsis: Eagerly wanting to have a last bloom of her youth, Mama Yeung conceals her stubborn husband and rebellious son, and steps into the new splendid world of pole dance. Yet, this secret has been accidentally revealed, putting her into a dilemma between fulfilling her family’s needs and pursuing her dream…

synopsis_lang.en: Eagerly wanting to have a last bloom of her youth, Mama Yeung conceals her stubborn husband and rebellious son, and steps into the new splendid world of pole dance. Yet, this secret has been accidentally revealed, putting her into a dilemma between fulfilling her family’s needs and pursuing her dream…
synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
美圓是個徹頭徹尾的師奶仔，枯燥的主婦生活佔據了她的人生，機緣巧合下，美圓卻意外踏進了五光十色的鋼管舞世界，展開了偷偷瞞著兒子爵珩和丈夫明林學跳鋼管舞的秘密旅程，生活從此添上色彩，更因此認識了班上倔強任性的年輕女生姍姍。

 

另一邊廂，年屆70歲、少女心爆棚的婆婆鳳梅積極用交友app尋找男友，卻因此被騙，只好搬入美圓家，為本來已經暗藏暗湧的許家帶來更多衝擊。

 

日子一天天過去，這對奇葩母女一邊與守舊的明林暗中角力，一邊努力捉緊自已即將流逝的青春。然而，美圓學跳鋼管舞的秘密即將被戳破… 美圓能否擁抱屬於自己的靈魂，尋回她的媽樣年華？

cast: Catherine Chau, Elaine Jin, Chan Charm Man Peter, Yeung Nga Man, Jayden Cheung
